name: Ooga Booga
summary: Forget humanity and return back to the old times, the times when The Oogas were running this planet, survive and strive with other Oogas while keeping your sanity with these evil dinosaurs roaming the planet, build, fight, and hunt to show your pride on this planet and prove to everyone that you are the best. Sail boats, make farms, trade, fight bosses, learn battle techniques, in Ooga Booga you can do ALL of this, download now to get the experience you've been waiting for!
